question: Where do we go to play on the swings? 🛝
explanation: Great job! We go to the park to play and have fun! 🌳
hint: It has lots of green grass and trees.

question: Where do we read lots of story books? 📚
explanation: Awesome! A library has many amazing books for us to read. 📚
hint: We must be very quiet here!

question: Where do we buy fresh apples and bananas? 🍎
explanation: Super! We buy yummy fruits and vegetables from the market. 🍎
hint: There are lots of shops here.

question: Where do we drop a letter to our friend? ✉️
explanation: Great job! We put letters in a red post box to send them! ✉️
hint: It is a tall red box on the street.

question: Where do we go to learn and write? ✏️
explanation: Fantastic! We go to school to learn new things every day! 🏫
hint: We take our bags and water bottles here.

question: Where do we go when we have a fever? 🤒
explanation: Awesome! Doctors in the hospital give us medicine to feel better. 🏥
hint: People wear white coats here.

question: Where does papa keep the money safe? 💰
explanation: Super! A bank is a safe place to keep our money. 💰
hint: It has big safes and guards.

question: Where do we buy a yummy birthday cake? 🎂
explanation: Brilliant! A bakery makes sweet cakes and fresh bread! 🎂
hint: It smells like sweet cookies inside.

question: Where do we see tall giraffes and monkeys? 🦁
explanation: Great job! The zoo is home to many amazing wild animals! 🦁
hint: You can hear lions roaring here.

question: Where do we wait to catch a bus? 🚌
explanation: Awesome! We stand in a line at the bus stand to get inside. 🚌
hint: Big vehicles stop here for people.

question: Where do we go to sit in a long train? 🚂
explanation: Super! Trains stop at the railway station to pick us up. 🚉
hint: You can hear a loud whistle here.

question: Where do we buy a new teddy bear? 🧸
explanation: Fantastic! A toy shop has cars, dolls, and teddy bears! 🧸
hint: It is a very fun shop for kids.

question: Where do we sit in a big hall to watch a movie? 🍿
explanation: Great job! We eat popcorn and watch movies on a big screen! 📽️
hint: It is dark inside until the picture starts.

question: Where do we sit and eat yummy pizza with family? 🍕
explanation: Awesome! A restaurant cooks tasty food for us to eat! 🍽️
hint: A waiter brings food to your table.

question: Where do we buy a band-aid and cough syrup? 🩹
explanation: Super! A pharmacy is a shop that sells medicines to heal us. 💊
hint: It usually has a green cross sign.

question: Where do the big red fire trucks wait? 🚒
explanation: Brilliant! The fire station keeps fire trucks ready to help people! 🚒
hint: Firefighters work here.

question: Where does the police officer work? 👮
explanation: Great job! Police officers work at the police station to keep us safe. 🚓
hint: You will see blue police cars outside.

question: Where do big airplanes fly high into the sky? ✈️
explanation: Awesome! Airplanes take off and land at the airport! 🛫
hint: You need a ticket and a passport here.

question: Where do we see little puppies and kittens? 🐶
explanation: Super! A pet shop has lovely animals we can take home as friends. 🐾
hint: It is full of cute, furry animals.

question: Where do we buy sweet chocolates and lollipops? 🍭
explanation: Fantastic! Sweet shops are full of colorful and tasty treats! 🍬
hint: It is full of yummy candies.

question: Who gives us our letters and parcels? 📦
explanation: Great job! The postman brings mail right to our door! 📯
hint: He carries a brown bag full of letters.

question: Who checks our tummy when we are sick? 🩺
explanation: Awesome! The doctor gives us medicine to make us feel strong again. 👩‍⚕️
hint: They wear a white coat and have a stethoscope.

question: Who helps everyone stay safe on the roads? 🚓
explanation: Super! Police officers protect us and keep the town very safe! 👮
hint: They blow a whistle and wear a uniform.

question: Who uses big hoses to put out a fire? 💦
explanation: Brilliant! Firefighters are very brave and put out hot fires! 🧑‍🚒
hint: They wear yellow and red helmets.

question: Who drives the big yellow school bus? 🚍
explanation: Great job! The bus driver takes us safely to school every morning! 🚌
hint: He sits at the front and holds the steering wheel.

question: Who makes fresh bread early in the morning? 🥖
explanation: Awesome! A baker bakes yummy bread and sweet cakes! 👨‍🍳
hint: They wear a tall white hat.

question: Who sells carrots and potatoes in the market? 🥕
explanation: Super! The vegetable seller brings healthy veggies for us to eat. 🥔
hint: They have a big cart full of green leaves.

question: Which van takes sick people quickly to the clinic? 🚑
explanation: Fantastic! An ambulance drives fast to help people get to the doctor! 🚑
hint: It has a loud siren and flashing lights.

question: Which long vehicle goes chug-chug on tracks? 🚆
explanation: Great job! A train has many bogeys and runs very fast on iron tracks! 🚂
hint: It moves on special rails, not on the road.

question: What rings loudly to say it is time to go home from school? 🔔
explanation: Awesome! The school bell tells us when class is over! 🔔
hint: Tring-tring! It is time to pack your bags.

question: Where can we buy stamps for an envelope? 📮
explanation: Super! The post office has stamps and envelopes to send letters. 🏣
hint: We give our parcels here.

question: Where do we go down the big fun slide? 🎢
explanation: Brilliant! We slide, swing, and run around joyfully in the park! 🌳
hint: It is outside and very green.

question: Where do we sleep at night with our family? 🛏️
explanation: Great job! Home is our lovely place where we sleep and rest. 🏠
hint: It has our living room and bedroom.

question: Where do we see kind nurses working? 👩‍⚕️
explanation: Awesome! Nurses work in the hospital to care for people! 🏥
hint: They help the doctors treat you.

question: Where do we see blackboards, desks, and chalk? 🏫
explanation: Super! Our classroom has desks for us to sit and learn! 🎒
hint: Our teacher writes on the board here.

question: Where are many bright shops next to each other? 🛍️
explanation: Fantastic! A market has lots of shops selling clothes, fruits, and toys! 🛒
hint: It is usually very busy and crowded.

question: Which color traffic light says STOP? 🛑
explanation: Great job! The red light tells all cars to stop safely! 🔴
hint: It is the color of an apple.

question: Where should we cross the busy road safely? 🦓
explanation: Awesome! Zebra crossings have white stripes for us to walk safely. 🦓
hint: It looks like the stripes on a black-and-white animal.

question: Who brings fresh white milk to our house? 🥛
explanation: Super! The milkman brings healthy milk for us to drink! 🥛
hint: He rides a cycle with metal cans.

question: Where do we buy colorful crayons and pencils? 🖍️
explanation: Brilliant! A stationery shop has amazing colors and notebooks! ✏️
hint: It sells things we use to draw and write.

question: Who cuts our hair nicely with scissors? ✂️
explanation: Great job! The barber cuts and styles our hair to make us look smart! 💈
hint: They use a comb and scissors.

question: Who fixes papa's car when it stops working? 🚗
explanation: Awesome! A mechanic uses tools to repair broken cars and bikes! 🔧
hint: They work in a garage.

question: Where do we go to wash our dirty car? 🧽
explanation: Super! At the car wash, lots of water and soap make the car shine! 🚙
hint: Big brushes spin to clean the vehicles here.

question: Who stitches our lovely school uniform? 🧵
explanation: Fantastic! A tailor uses a sewing machine to make our clothes fit perfectly! 🪡
hint: They use thread and a needle.

question: Where do we see beautiful red roses and green plants? 🌹
explanation: Great job! A garden is full of sweet-smelling flowers and butterflies! 🌷
hint: People water the plants here every day.

question: Where do we run fast and play football? ⚽
explanation: Awesome! The playground is the best open place to run and play games! 🏃
hint: It is a very big open field.

question: Who helps the doctor look after sick people? 🏥
explanation: Super! Nurses are very kind and give us medicine to heal. 👩‍⚕️
hint: They check your temperature in the hospital.

question: Where do we buy new shiny black shoes? 👟
explanation: Brilliant! The shoe shop has sneakers, sandals, and school shoes! 👞
hint: You try things on your feet here.

question: Where do we eat sweet cold ice cream? 🍦
explanation: Great job! Ice cream parlours have many yummy flavors to choose from! 🍧
hint: They sell vanilla and chocolate cones.

question: Who flies the big airplane way up in the sky? 👨‍✈️
explanation: Awesome! The pilot sits at the front and flies the airplane safely! ✈️
hint: They wear a nice uniform and sunglasses.
